content.value_statement: Marketing teams lose context when campaign findings, decisions, and open loops are spread across sessions. This skill organizes project memory into hot, warm, and archived layers with clear privacy cleanup steps.
actual_capabilities: Initializes memory folders and templates for SEO/GEO, influencer, paid, and email work.
Maintains hot cache, open loops, decisions, glossary, and archive paths.
Guides lookup across HOT, WARM, and COLD memory layers before asking for clarification.
Applies promotion and demotion rules using explicit requests and observable timestamps.
Supports confirmed GDPR and CCPA working-tree purge logs with stated limitations.
limitations: It does not erase git history or prove complete legal erasure.
It does not score content quality, domain authority, ads, or email quality.
It depends on user input or connected tools for current campaign data.
It does not enforce lawful basis or replace legal review.

use_cases.title: Keep Campaign Context Stable
use_cases.description: Maintain a compact hot cache of current priorities, metrics, competitors, and decisions across sessions.

use_cases.title: Archive Analysis Outputs
use_cases.description: Move detailed research, audits, readbacks, and performance notes into predictable memory paths for later retrieval.
use_cases.target_user: SEO, paid, email, or influencer operator

use_cases.title: Document Privacy Cleanup
use_cases.description: Find memory references for a data subject, ask before changes, and record a subject-free purge log entry.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize Project Memory
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up marketing memory for my new project. Ask me for missing project facts, create the HOT/WARM/COLD structure, and propose a hot-cache outline.

prompt_templates.title: Review Memory Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Review memory health for this project. Check hot-cache size, stale files, missing frontmatter, open loops, and recommend archive actions.

prompt_templates.title: Update After Campaign Readback
prompt_templates.prompt: Update memory after this campaign readback. Promote durable findings, archive detailed outputs, update decisions only with user-approved facts, and provide a handoff summary.

prompt_templates.title: Run Privacy Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a privacy cleanup workflow for [entity]. Find possible memory matches, show me the affected files, ask before redaction or deletion, and log a subject-free purge record.

output_examples.input: Set up memory for a new e-commerce SEO project.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a proposed hot-cache outline, required memory folders, missing project questions, and a handoff summary for the next skill.
The skill reports hot-cache size, stale files, missing frontmatter, open loops, and recommended archive actions without changing files unless asked.

output_examples.input: Purge references to a named creator from memory.
output_examples.output: The skill lists matching memory files, asks for confirmation, applies the chosen redaction or deletion, and records a subject-free purge note.

best_practices: Keep hot-cache entries short, current, and tied to active decisions or priorities.
Record user approval before treating a decision as authoritative.
Use dated archive files so future sessions can trace when facts changed.
anti_patterns: Do not store every analysis detail in the hot cache.
Do not treat inferred decisions as approved decisions.
Do not promise complete privacy erasure when git history still contains old data.

faq.question: What does this skill store?
faq.answer: It stores campaign context such as priorities, decisions, glossary terms, open loops, metrics, and archived analysis outputs.

faq.question: Does it run marketing audits?
faq.answer: No. It stores and organizes audit outputs from other skills but does not score content, authority, ads, or email quality.

faq.question: Can it work without connected tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It can ask for manual inputs and maintain memory from user-provided facts.

faq.question: Does it delete data automatically?
faq.answer: No. Purge actions require user confirmation and only affect the working tree described in the skill.

faq.question: How does it keep sessions focused?
faq.answer: It keeps current context in a small hot cache and moves detailed or stale information into warm and cold storage.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a marketing project needs reliable cross-session memory, archive discipline, and clear privacy cleanup records.
